items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: They organized... a band for that boat, the Mark Twain... So we got that Young Men From New Orleans together... That was your Young Men From New Orleans.

ctx.x: Right after that... Not long afterwards... Well, this was '56. I toured around, and I got a letter from Joe Glaser that Louis wanted to sign me up and go on the road. Scovill(?) wanted me to come back with him and play with him, and different... I got a lot of offers. But I stayed here, playing around in these different clubs and everything. Anyway, it goes on up to... They organized... Harvey Brooks and somebody from Disneyland come up and was talking about Young Men From New Orleans...oh, a band for that boat,…

This was probably June...or no, in May, because the season would open the first of June. So we got that Young Men From New Orleans together, Monette Moore, the vocalist, Johnny St. Cyr, Harvey Brooks, Mike DeLeigh(?) and Alton Redd on drums. That was your Young Men From New Orleans.
